findings.qualification: The headings retain thousands for copper, silver, electrum, and gold, and hundreds for platinum. Rows J-N preserve five literal pieces-per-individual qualifiers and are not multiplied by header scales. This confirms the bounded cell transcription; it does not assign value-target, context, or default-selection grades.

sourceSupportedDistinctions: Number Appearing is an adaptable average-spread guideline, not a fixed dungeon-population prescription.
% IN LAIR is an encounter-location chance, distinct from probabilities in treasure-table cells.
Individual treasure and lair-only treasure differ; lair status can remain unknown until after an encounter.
A lair encounter and a Treasure Type do not guarantee treasure gained by defeating the creature.
Separate category rolls can leave a lair with no wealth, including magic items.
Use mean-number and profile-specific adjustments; the source generally discourages Treasure Types for dungeon-guarded treasure.
A parenthesized X 10 multiplier remains distinct from a separate Type X code.
